benchmark: NativeStatsSampler explicit selection and timestamp formatting
scope: Optimized native Swift, one process. Selection and timestamp construction only, no runtime, XPC calls, VM, or workload timings.
method: Each size/cardinality uses deterministic 64-byte IDs, including one repeated ID and 50% duplication. Nine interleaved batch pairs in alternating order. Values are median elapsed nanoseconds per invocation, after verifying identical ordered output. Timestamp section checks the wire format at two dates and measures 100 calls per arm per round.

reproduction: Save the swift_source member as main.swift. Compile with xcrun swiftc -O main.swift -o measure and run ./measure. Threshold selection was informed by a separate array-versus-unconditional-Set screen.
